scenarios.hypothesis_summary: Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito entered the storeroom first for toner, Mr Abiodun Castellanos entered about a minute later for paper, and the two argued about a missed deadline. Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito alone shoved Mr Abiodun Castellanos, who struck the grey cabinet, then Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito left for the studio while Mr Abiodun Castellanos later got out to the corridor and sat against the wall until Ms Clementine Alvarenga found him and called for help.

supporting_facts.text: Access and CCTV place C-017 in the storeroom from about 21:12 and C-041 entering about a minute later, with the door then closed.
A faint thud and raised voices were recorded while both were inside, and Mr Abiodun Castellanos reported an argument, a hard shove and hitting the grey cabinet.
Blood was found on the cabinet edge and storeroom floor, the room was disturbed around the door, and the medical findings are consistent with a fall against a hard edge.

Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito said he was alone, nowhere near the corridor at 21:30 and did not touch Mr Abiodun Castellanos, which conflicts with the access, CCTV and exit records showing him leaving the storeroom at 21:31.

contradicted_points.text: Mr Abiodun Castellanos said he entered at about 21:15 and that the colleague came in right after him, but the logs put C-017 first at 21:12 and C-041 second at 21:13; exact wording of the order conflicts, though the times are approximate.

CCTV records C-017 leaving alone at 21:31 and the storeroom door not opening again in the following log entry, yet Mr Abiodun Castellanos was found in the corridor at about 21:39-21:40; the evidence does not show how or when he exited.
The medical note says the mechanism cannot be determined from the injuries alone, so a shove versus another fall mechanism is not medically decided.
